About this design preview

Cabinet front positions, widths, heights, divisions, continuous worktops and the floor outline are read directly from your supplied SketchUp file. All 63 root cabinet and architectural faces are retained. The Ty human figure is excluded. Internal hardware is a design visualization; final construction and appliance clearances require site confirmation.

The pantry has fixed shelves and hinged shutters. The separate tall unit has baskets that slide out together with its shutter. The orange section retains its two original front divisions. Both red tandem sections retain their original divisions. The maroon section keeps its single outer shutter with two internal wicker baskets. No cutlery organizers have been added.

Finish choices and the quotation checkbox are saved in this browser on this device. This preview does not submit approval to the studio or synchronize between devices. No quotation rates have been entered.
